svg.title: Floyd phase 1 (meet) and phase 2 (find the entry) on the loop example
svg.desc: Phase 1: slow and fast positions per step and the gap; they meet on 5 after 4 steps. Phase 2: p from the head and slow from 5, one step each, meet on 3 after 2 steps.
svg.text: gap = single steps for fast to reach slow
meet on 5: a + b = 4, so b = 2
